dataset.name: Shenzhen EV charging (PolyU + Autosun), Mendeley 10.17632/c7gg94tmvz.3
dataset.paper: Yang et al., Nature Communications 17:974 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41467-025-67703-7
dataset.label: 1 = charging record from a faulty battery, per the dataset authors (constant per session). Faults, not fires: no link to fire outcomes is documented.

threshold_method: stations whose normal sessions reach 'slow' > 5x the budget under robust (median-over-stations) thresholds are flagged for a hardware check; final thresholds are pooled quantiles over the other training stations' normal sessions

test_runtime_station_check.rule: flag when >10% of a station's last 50 sessions reached 'slow' (after at least 20) and that share is more than 3x the median of the other stations
